name: me-session-detail-200
notes: Pins the M8.11 session-detail contract: the list row reused verbatim (same totals as GET /v1/me/sessions) plus the per-turn detail, oldest first. The seeded session is root (1M+1M tokens) + one child (500+500) at cheap-model $0.5/$1.5 per 1M, so list price is (1000500*0.5 + 1000500*1.5)/1e6 = $2.001. No real price is invented: the rates are the mock registry's test prices.
recorded_from: mock-upstream: canned local-endpoint response shape for GET /v1/me/sessions/resp-root1, 2026-11-19. Recorded mock data, NOT a live provider call. No upstream is involved: the session rows are seeded in the test from the mock registry (cheap-model, prov-a). The test replaces the placeholder Authorization header with its own issued test key.
